prompts: What is the goal of OpenEuroLLM?
first_answers: OpenEuroLLM is a European project that develops a series of open, multilingual foundation models for the EU's official languages and beyond. It started on 1 February 2025, is funded by the EU's Digital Europe Programme, and is coordinated by Charles University with AMD Silo AI as co-lead. Models, code, data, and evaluations are published openly at https://huggingface.co/openeurollm and https://github.com/OpenEuroLLM.

OpenEuroLLM is a consortium of about twenty European universities, research organisations, companies, and HPC centres that builds transparent, open-source multilingual language models for Europe. The project began on 1 February 2025 with funding from the EU's Digital Europe Programme; more information is at https://openeurollm.eu/.
follow_ups: Is it a product of one company?
second_answers: It is coordinated by Jan Hajič of Charles University in Czechia and co-led by Peter Sarlin of AMD Silo AI in Finland.
No. It is a European consortium of universities, research organisations, companies, and HPC centres, coordinated by Charles University and co-led by AMD Silo AI.
